name: End card decode
looks: The through-line mark pulses with a glow ring as the name decodes in letter by letter, each one flickering through scramble glyphs before locking to its real letter on its own staggered timing. An italic line, a hairline draw-across, and the call to action typing on in mono follow, with a small marker spinning in as the audio fades.
build: Hold each letter as a span with a hidden final glyph and a scramble glyph chosen from a seeded random function of the frame, so every render matches; spread the lock times unevenly across letters rather than in order. Reveal the line beneath with a clip-path and slide, and the hairline with a scaleX draw.
sound: Glitch ticks under the decode, a hit on the last letter locking, and the bed fading out over the last 1.5 s.
prompt: Close the film on an end card: a pulsing mark, a name that decodes letter by letter out of scrambled glyphs before locking into place, a short supporting line, a hairline that draws across, and the call to action typing on. Let the finished card hold for at least a second before the audio fades.
source: the 2026 Opus showreels; built in examples/reel-2026-10-06.html, S9.
